expectations.text: Applies the Omnibus scope correctly: mandatory CSRD now covers large undertakings with MORE THAN 1,000 employees AND turnover above €450M (Directive (EU) 2026/470) — 800 employees means out of mandatory scope regardless of turnover
expectations.evidence: "employees above 1,000 AND turnover above EUR 450M... At 800 employees you fail the employee limb... you are out of scope"

expectations.text: Points to the voluntary standard as law: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1560 (OJ September 21, in force September 24, 2026), VSME-based with Basic/Comprehensive modules
expectations.evidence: Misstates legal form: VSME "endorsed... (Commission Recommendation of July 2025)"; no Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1560 or Sept 2026 in-force status

expectations.text: Explains the value-chain cap: in-scope CSRD reporters may not demand more from ≤1,000-employee value-chain partners than the voluntary standard's content — the shield against over-broad customer questionnaires
expectations.evidence: "in-scope companies cannot require from value-chain partners with up to 1,000 employees more than what is in the voluntary standard for SMEs... you sit within this protection"

expectations.text: Notes member-state transposition of the Omnibus scope changes is due March 19, 2027 (with major states like Germany still pending)
expectations.evidence: No March 19, 2027 transposition deadline and no Germany-pending note; only "member states must transpose... there may be gaps"

expectations.text: Gives practical advice: adopt the voluntary standard once, reuse it across customer requests
expectations.evidence: "Create a single, standard response pack so that you answer all customers with the same data" built on VSME Basic/Comprehensive
